Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電梯服務需求累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Accumulating demand for elevators", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電梯服務需求累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accumulating demand for elevators” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「電梯服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulating demand for elevators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「電梯服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulating demand for elevators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「電梯服務需求累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulating demand for elevators, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「電梯服務需求累積」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulating demand for elevators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電梯服務需求累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accumulating demand for elevators"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電梯服務需求累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accumulating demand for elevators: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電梯服務需求累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accumulating demand for elevators” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulating demand for elevators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「電梯服務需求累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulating demand for elevators. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電梯服務需求累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accumulating demand for elevators" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows.
quiz.explanation: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣與使用性測試推論
stages.titleEn: User-capability case matrix & Inference from usability trials
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「使用者能力案例矩陣」與「使用性測試推論」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "User-capability case matrix" and "Inference from usability trials": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: User-capability case matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「使用者能力案例矩陣」如何影響軌道運輸無障礙月台的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “User-capability case matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Accessible platforms for rail transit”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「使用者能力案例矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “User-capability case matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「使用者能力案例矩陣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “User-capability case matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣
knowledge.text: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「使用者能力案例矩陣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "User-capability case matrix" is correct?
options: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以不同輔具、視覺與聽覺需求檢查同一路徑，要求每個介面都有對應的可觀察任務。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Check one route with different mobility, vision and hearing needs, requiring an observable task for each interface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 使用者能力案例矩陣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: User-capability case matrix: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「使用者能力案例矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 本單元檢查受試者是否涵蓋真正的能力差異，強調有限次順利通行不能證明所有使用者都無障礙。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「使用性測試推論」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether participants represent meaningful capability differences; a finite set of successful trips does not establish access for every user. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inference from usability trials” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

optionsEn: An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 使用性測試推論：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inference from usability trials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「使用性測試推論」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inference from usability trials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「使用性測試推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from usability trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「使用性測試推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for inference from usability trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「使用性測試推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from usability trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「使用性測試推論」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「使用性測試推論」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inference from usability trials"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 使用性測試推論：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inference from usability trials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「使用性測試推論」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inference from usability trials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「使用性測試推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for inference from usability trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「使用性測試推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for inference from usability trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「使用性測試推論」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inference from usability trials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路車站排煙整合
summary: 本課聚焦車站煙流風路與疏散需求的整合。從排煙斷面速度分布建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風速量級與壓力與控制與照明備援連成可驗證的介面，最後以排煙模式整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies integrating station smoke paths airflow and egress requirements. Start with velocity distribution in exhaust sections to define physical or information boundaries, connect air-speed scale and pressure with backup for controls and lighting as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through integrated smoke-mode cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究排煙斷面速度分布。原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。敏感度只改 A=16 至 17.6 m2，輸出變為 1.81818 m/s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究風機壓升能量帳：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate velocity distribution in exhaust sections. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. For sensitivity, change only A=16 to 17.6 m2; the output becomes 1.81818 m/s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate fan pressure and energy accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 排煙斷面速度分布與風機壓升能量帳
stages.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections & Fan pressure and energy accounting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排煙斷面速度分布」與「風機壓升能量帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections" and "Fan pressure and energy accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排煙斷面速度分布」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排煙斷面速度分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排煙斷面速度分布」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity distribution in exhaust sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排煙斷面速度分布
knowledge.text: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排煙斷面速度分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Velocity distribution in exhaust sections" is correct?
options: 一個測點風速符合目標就能證明整個煙流場符合需求
本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。
風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成
optionsEn: One velocity reading at target proves that the entire smoke-flow field meets requirements.
Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke.
A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved.
quiz.explanation: 本單元從多點風速還原斷面流量，區分局部高速射流與真正能帶走煙氣的整體流路。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct section flow from multiple velocity readings, separating a local fast jet from a complete path capable of transporting smoke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排煙斷面速度分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Velocity distribution in exhaust sections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排煙斷面速度分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風機壓升能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fan pressure and energy accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測流量、前後壓差與電功率，對照風門位置並檢查各項能量是否一致。以「風機壓升能量帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow, pressure rise and electrical power together, correlate with damper position, and check energy consistency. For fan pressure and energy accounting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 風機壓升能量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fan pressure and energy accounting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風機壓升能量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fan pressure and energy accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風門位置回授正常但機械連桿脫落會形成錯誤狀態，僅看馬達運轉訊號無法證明有足夠送風。回到「風機壓升能量帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A detached damper linkage can coexist with apparently normal position feedback; a motor-running signal does not prove adequate airflow. Trace the input chain for fan pressure and energy accounting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機馬達正在轉動就表示所需通風量一定已達成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A running fan motor proves that the required airflow has been achieved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 門口與旁通流量與風速量級與壓力
stages.titleEn: Doorway and bypass flow & Air-speed scale and pressure
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「門口與旁通流量」與「風速量級與壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Doorway and bypass flow" and "Air-speed scale and pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 門口與旁通流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Doorway and bypass flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門口與旁通流量」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Doorway and bypass flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以孔口近似比較門開度與壓差，明示此模型無法解析上下反向的分層煙流。開口通風量由壓差驅動，受面積與縮流損失共同控制。流量和壓差平方根成正比，不是線性比例；旁通開口增加可能減輕壓力卻同時改變煙氣路徑，因此開口位置和通風模式必須一起討論。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門口與旁通流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare door opening and pressure difference with an orifice approximation, explicitly excluding counterflowing stratified smoke from the model. Pressure difference drives opening flow, with area and contraction losses jointly controlling it. Flow scales with the square root of pressure rather than linearly. Adding a bypass can relieve pressure while changing smoke paths, so location and ventilation mode must be considered together. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Doorway and bypass flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: discharge coefficient Cd=0.65 1; opening area A=4 m2; pressure difference dp=80 Pa; air density rho=1.2 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門口與旁通流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Doorway and bypass flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Compare door opening and pressure difference with an orifice approximation, explicitly excluding counterflowing stratified smoke from the model. Pressure difference drives opening flow, with area and contraction losses jointly controlling it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：開口壓差增加四倍時流量一定增加四倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Quadrupling pressure difference necessarily quadruples opening flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 門口與旁通流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Doorway and bypass flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門口與旁通流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Doorway and bypass flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量係數 Cd=0.65 1；開口面積 A=4 m2；兩側壓差 dp=80 Pa；空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3。公式 y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho)，代入得 y=30.0222 m3/s。邊界：固定流量係數的不可壓縮孔口近似，未含雙向分層流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: discharge coefficient Cd=0.65 1; opening area A=4 m2; pressure difference dp=80 Pa; air density rho=1.2 kg/m3. Formula y=Cd*A*sqrt(2*dp/rho) gives y=30.0222 m3/s. Boundary: Incompressible orifice approximation with fixed coefficient; bidirectional stratified flow is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測開口兩側壓差與斷面流量，將不同開度下的結果畫成流量對壓差平方根。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pressure difference and section flow, then plot flow against square-root pressure for several openings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測開口兩側壓差與斷面流量，將不同開度下的結果畫成流量對壓差平方根。以「門口與旁通流量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 風速量級與壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air-speed scale and pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風速量級與壓力」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air-speed scale and pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把動壓作為局部量級參考，另量門兩側靜壓以避免將迎風測壓值直接當作門負荷。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。實際瞬變壓力仍受隧道阻塞率、旁通開口與波傳反射影響；動壓不是任何測點必定出現的靜壓差，兩者不能直接等同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風速量級與壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use dynamic pressure as a local scale reference and separately measure static pressure on both sides of a door instead of equating an impact reading with door load. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading. Actual transients also depend on blockage, bypass openings and wave reflections. Dynamic pressure is not automatically the static pressure difference measured at a particular location. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air-speed scale and pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風速量級與壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

stages.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界與偵測至風路建立
stages.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries & From detection to established airflow
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「煙流與清空時間邊界」與「偵測至風路建立」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Smoke and clearance-time boundaries" and "From detection to established airflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「煙流與清空時間邊界」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「煙流與清空時間邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「煙流與清空時間邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界
knowledge.text: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。
knowledge.textEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「煙流與清空時間邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Smoke and clearance-time boundaries" is correct?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將需求疏散時間分成反應、移動與服務，另列尚未求得的可用安全時間作為缺失輸入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate required egress time into response, movement and service, explicitly listing uncomputed available safe time as missing evidence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「煙流與清空時間邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。

Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 煙流與清空時間邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Smoke and clearance-time boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「煙流與清空時間邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「煙流與清空時間邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For smoke and clearance-time boundaries, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「煙流與清空時間邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for smoke and clearance-time boundaries, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Smoke and clearance-time boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。回到「煙流與清空時間邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “From detection to established airflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元記錄偵測、模式判定、風門動作與氣流建立，避免以電氣啟動回授代替真正風路形成。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偵測至風路建立」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record detection, mode decision, damper travel and airflow establishment, avoiding substitution of electrical start feedback for an established flow path. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “From detection to established airflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偵測至風路建立」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “From detection to established airflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 偵測至風路建立：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偵測至風路建立」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “From detection to established airflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「偵測至風路建立」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for from detection to established airflow. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 控制與照明備援與低照度疏散辨識
stages.titleEn: Backup for controls and lighting & Egress recognition under low lighting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制與照明備援」與「低照度疏散辨識」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backup for controls and lighting" and "Egress recognition under low lighting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制與照明備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backup for controls and lighting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制與照明備援」如何影響鐵路車站排煙整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup for controls and lighting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway-station smoke-control integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把控制器與指示照明負載獨立列帳，明示小型電池算例不代表整組排煙風機的供電。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制與照明備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Account separately for controls and directional lighting, explicitly noting that this small-battery example does not represent power for the complete smoke-exhaust fan set. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup for controls and lighting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制與照明備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backup for controls and lighting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Account separately for controls and directional lighting, explicitly noting that this small-battery example does not represent power for the complete smoke-exhaust fan set. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 控制與照明備援：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backup for controls and lighting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制與照明備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup for controls and lighting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instructionEn: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately. Explain the causal direction for backup for controls and lighting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 共用風路失效原因：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元把供電、風門卡滯與流路阻塞分開建樹，要求各原因有不同量測證據而非只看運轉訊號。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共用風路失效原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault causes in shared airflow paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

title: 地下車站活塞風控制
summary: 本課聚焦列車活塞效應旁通開口與壓力瞬變。從列車誘導壓力量級建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把風機與活塞作用疊合與壓力量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以不同列車通過情境整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies train piston effects bypass openings and pressure transients. Start with scale of train-induced pressure to define physical or information boundaries, connect fans interacting with piston effects with combining pressure measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scenarios for different train passages. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究列車誘導壓力量級。原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。敏感度只改 v=15 至 16.5 m/s，輸出變為 163.35 Pa；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究活塞風斷面積分：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate scale of train-induced pressure. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. For sensitivity, change only v=15 to 16.5 m/s; the output becomes 163.35 Pa. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate section integration of piston airflow: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: volume flow Q=32 m3/s; effective airflow area A=16 m2. Formula y=Q/A gives y=2 m/s. Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 列車誘導壓力量級與活塞風斷面積分
stages.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure & Section integration of piston airflow
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車誘導壓力量級」與「活塞風斷面積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scale of train-induced pressure" and "Section integration of piston airflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車誘導壓力量級」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale of train-induced pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以局部風速平方比較壓力量級，保留列車阻塞率與波反射尚未求解的差異。動壓與風速平方成正比，這有助判斷列車活塞作用與門扇負載的量級。實際瞬變壓力仍受隧道阻塞率、旁通開口與波傳反射影響；動壓不是任何測點必定出現的靜壓差，兩者不能直接等同。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車誘導壓力量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure scales using local air-speed squared, retaining the unsolved influence of train blockage and wave reflection. Dynamic pressure scales with speed squared, helping estimate the magnitude of train-induced airflow and door loading. Actual transients also depend on blockage, bypass openings and wave reflections. Dynamic pressure is not automatically the static pressure difference measured at a particular location. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale of train-induced pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列車誘導壓力量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale of train-induced pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：空氣密度 rho=1.2 kg/m3；代表風速 v=15 m/s。公式 y=0.5*rho*v*v，代入得 y=135 Pa。邊界：低馬赫數局部量級估算，不是全隧道壓力波解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: air density rho=1.2 kg/m3; representative air speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=0.5*rho*v*v gives y=135 Pa. Boundary: Local low-Mach-number scale estimate, not a tunnel-wide pressure-wave solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale of train-induced pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車誘導壓力量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale of train-induced pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測列車速度、局部風速與兩側靜壓，觀察峰值時刻及符號是否相符。以「列車誘導壓力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize train speed, local air speed and static pressure on both sides, comparing peak timing and sign. For scale of train-induced pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把代表風速 v 從 15 改成 16.5 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 135 變為 163.35 Pa。先說明「列車誘導壓力量級」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only representative air speed v from 15 to 16.5 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 135 to 163.35 Pa. Explain the causal direction for scale of train-induced pressure, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A probe facing the flow can measure total rather than static pressure and overstate door loading; time averaging can hide transient peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For scale of train-induced pressure, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

steps.title: 列車誘導壓力量級：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列車誘導壓力量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale of train-induced pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Trace the input chain for scale of train-induced pressure. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把測壓管朝向流動形成的總壓誤當靜壓會高估門扇負載，時間平均又可能掩蓋短暫峰值。回到「列車誘導壓力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

steps.title: 活塞風斷面積分：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元在列車進出站期間量測有正負號的速度，防止正反流動被平均後誤判為持續單向送風。平均風速是流量除以有效斷面，局部阻塞與流場分離可讓同一平均值對應很不均勻的速度。風向與煙氣來源位置同樣重要；正常通風的舒適性目標和火災時的煙流控制目標不能共用一個數字就視為完成驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「活塞風斷面積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure signed velocity during train entry and departure, preventing reversing flow from being mistaken for sustained one-way ventilation. Mean air speed is flow divided by effective area, but obstruction and separation can produce highly nonuniform fields at the same mean. Direction and smoke-source location also matter. Normal comfort ventilation and emergency smoke control cannot be validated by one shared number alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section integration of piston airflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：體積流量 Q=32 m3/s；有效通風面積 A=16 m2。公式 y=Q/A，代入得 y=2 m/s。邊界：不可壓縮均勻截面平均，未求解火災浮力、毒性或能見度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Boundary: Incompressible cross-section mean; fire buoyancy, toxicity and visibility are not solved.
