steps.objective: 說明「風機與活塞作用疊合」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fans interacting with piston effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以穩態功率帳作基準，再標記列車通過造成的工作點偏移，避免假設風機流量始終固定。風機輸入功率由流量乘壓升再除效率估算。壓力不足與流路阻力增加都會改變工作點，不能把銘牌額定流量視為任何風道中都能達成；備援風機還可能共享同一阻塞路徑而無法提供預想的獨立能力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風機與活塞作用疊合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a steady power balance as a reference, then mark operating-point shifts during train passage instead of assuming constant fan flow. Fan input power is flow times pressure rise divided by efficiency. Inadequate pressure and increased duct resistance shift the operating point; nameplate flow is not guaranteed in every duct. Redundant fans may also share a blocked path and fail to provide the expected independent capability. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fans interacting with piston effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：流量 Q=40 m3/s；總壓升 dp=600 Pa；總效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=Q*dp/eta/1000，代入得 y=34.2857 kW。邊界：單一穩態工作點，未含風機曲線、失速或高溫效率變動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: flow Q=40 m3/s; total pressure rise dp=600 Pa; overall efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=Q*dp/eta/1000 gives y=34.2857 kW. Boundary: One steady operating point without fan-curve shape, stall or high-temperature efficiency change. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 壓力峰值取樣解析：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元由壓力取樣頻率直接計算相鄰時間間隔，檢查感測頻寬、濾波及取樣是否會漏掉門負載的短暫峰值。壓力時間序列的相鄰樣點間隔由取樣頻率倒數決定，短於此間隔的事件可能完全落在兩點之間。提高頻率仍需要適當感測頻寬與抗混疊濾波，資料記錄器和感測器中較慢的一環會限制真實解析度；只增加輸出的資料筆數不會補回已被濾掉的峰值。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等間隔時間取樣，未代表感測器頻寬或峰值重建精度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力峰值取樣解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate time intervals directly from pressure sampling frequency and examine whether sensor bandwidth, filtering or sampling misses brief door-load peaks. The interval between pressure samples is the reciprocal of sampling frequency, so an event shorter than that interval can fall entirely between observations. A higher rate still needs appropriate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering. The slower part of the sensor-recorder chain limits actual resolution; producing more output rows cannot restore an already filtered peak. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Equally spaced temporal samples, not sensor bandwidth or peak-reconstruction accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling resolution for pressure peaks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列車風壓事件同步」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Synchronizing train and pressure events” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「列車風壓事件同步」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For synchronizing train and pressure events, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「列車風壓事件同步」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for synchronizing train and pressure events, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 列車風壓事件同步：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Synchronizing train and pressure events: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列車風壓事件同步」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Synchronizing train and pressure events” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「列車風壓事件同步」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for synchronizing train and pressure events. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 壓力量測誤差合成與風門反應時間鏈
stages.titleEn: Combining pressure measurement uncertainty & Damper-response timing chain
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓力量測誤差合成」與「風門反應時間鏈」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Combining pressure measurement uncertainty" and "Damper-response timing chain": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓力量測誤差合成：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Combining pressure measurement uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力量測誤差合成」如何影響地下車站活塞風控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combining pressure measurement uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以帕斯卡為單位合成兩個獨立壓力通道的標準差，另列共用參考壓力與校正偏差以避免低估不確定度。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機壓力標準差，不是最大門負荷或確定壓差界限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力量測誤差合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine standard deviations of two independent pressure channels in pascals, separately retaining common reference-pressure and calibration biases to avoid understated uncertainty. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random pressure standard deviations, not maximum door load or a deterministic pressure-difference bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Combining pressure measurement uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立壓力通道一標準差 s1=3 Pa；獨立壓力通道二標準差 s2=4 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent pressure standard deviation s1=3 Pa; second independent pressure standard deviation s2=4 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力量測誤差合成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Combining pressure measurement uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 壓力量測誤差合成：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Combining pressure measurement uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力量測誤差合成」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Combining pressure measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立壓力通道一標準差 s1=3 Pa；獨立壓力通道二標準差 s2=4 Pa。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 Pa。邊界：獨立隨機壓力標準差，不是最大門負荷或確定壓差界限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent pressure standard deviation s1=3 Pa; second independent pressure standard deviation s2=4 Pa. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 Pa. Boundary: Independent random pressure standard deviations, not maximum door load or a deterministic pressure-difference bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damper-response timing chain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Piston-wind control in underground stations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元分開通訊命令、致動器移動和壓力實際變化，避免以風門已收到命令推論壓力已被抑制。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風門反應時間鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Explain the causal direction for scenarios for different train passages, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不同列車通過情境」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenarios for different train passages"?
options: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不同列車通過情境：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenarios for different train passages: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不同列車通過情境」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenarios for different train passages” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「不同列車通過情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for scenarios for different train passages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「不同列車通過情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for scenarios for different train passages. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不同列車通過情境」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenarios for different train passages" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
風速加倍時動壓也只會跟著加倍
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Doubling air speed merely doubles dynamic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道
summary: 本課聚焦隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散。從步道距離與協助時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把串行疏散時間帳與下車匯流區密度連成可驗證的介面，最後以受控演練證據安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation. Start with walkway distance and assistance time to define physical or information boundaries, connect serial accounting of egress time with density in alighting merge areas as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence planning for controlled exercises. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究步道距離與協助時間。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。敏感度只改 speed=0.8 至 0.88 m/s，輸出變為 171.364 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究步道局部有效淨寬：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate walkway distance and assistance time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. For sensitivity, change only speed=0.8 to 0.88 m/s; the output becomes 171.364 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local effective walkway width: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 步道距離與協助時間與步道局部有效淨寬
stages.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time & Local effective walkway width
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步道距離與協助時間」與「步道局部有效淨寬」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Walkway distance and assistance time" and "Local effective walkway width": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道距離與協助時間」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Walkway distance and assistance time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道距離與協助時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Walkway distance and assistance time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Walkway distance and assistance time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步道距離與協助時間
knowledge.text: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。
knowledge.textEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「步道距離與協助時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Walkway distance and assistance time" is correct?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「步道距離與協助時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Walkway distance and assistance time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「步道距離與協助時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Walkway distance and assistance time", which statement holds?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同
原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「步道距離與協助時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Walkway distance and assistance time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「步道距離與協助時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For walkway distance and assistance time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for walkway distance and assistance time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 步道距離與協助時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Walkway distance and assistance time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「步道距離與協助時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Walkway distance and assistance time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for walkway distance and assistance time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「步道距離與協助時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Walkway distance and assistance time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 步道局部有效淨寬：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local effective walkway width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道局部有效淨寬」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local effective walkway width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元量測電纜箱、扶手與設備突出物造成的縮口，檢查上游寬步道是否仍受下游窄門控制。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道局部有效淨寬」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local effective walkway width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「步道局部有效淨寬」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local effective walkway width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步道局部有效淨寬
knowledge.text: 本單元量測電纜箱、扶手與設備突出物造成的縮口，檢查上游寬步道是否仍受下游窄門控制。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For local effective walkway width, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

stages.title: 高程轉換與橫坡與串行疏散時間帳

steps.title: 高程轉換與橫坡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation changes and cross-slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程轉換與橫坡」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation changes and cross-slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較車門下車處、聯絡通道與出口的高差，另列局部台階及坡道平台的連續性需求。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程轉換與橫坡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare elevation changes at train exits, cross-passages and final exits, separately retaining local steps and continuity at ramp landings. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elevation changes and cross-slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Compare elevation changes at train exits, cross-passages and final exits, separately retaining local steps and continuity at ramp landings. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 高程轉換與橫坡：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高程轉換與橫坡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elevation changes and cross-slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 高程轉換與橫坡：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高程轉換與橫坡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elevation changes and cross-slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「高程轉換與橫坡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for elevation changes and cross-slope. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 串行疏散時間帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Serial accounting of egress time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串行疏散時間帳」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Serial accounting of egress time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在原創假想人數下建立時間帳，明列煙氣條件與可用安全時間沒有被此公式求解。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串行疏散時間帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a timing account for an original assumed population, explicitly recording that smoke conditions and available safe time are not solved by the formula. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Serial accounting of egress time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「串行疏散時間帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 串行疏散時間帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Serial accounting of egress time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「串行疏散時間帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Serial accounting of egress time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「串行疏散時間帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.textEn: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. knowledge.title: 根因確認

stages.title: 步道照度與暗區與緊急照明能量
stages.titleEn: Walkway illuminance and dark zones & Emergency-lighting energy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「步道照度與暗區」與「緊急照明能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Walkway illuminance and dark zones" and "Emergency-lighting energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 步道照度與暗區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Walkway illuminance and dark zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「步道照度與暗區」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Walkway illuminance and dark zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元沿實際行走面布點量測，對照設備遮影與轉彎處的方向辨識而非只查燈具數量。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「步道照度與暗區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure along the actual walking surface, examining equipment shadows and direction recognition at turns instead of merely counting luminaires. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Walkway illuminance and dark zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「步道照度與暗區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Walkway illuminance and dark zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 步道照度與暗區
knowledge.text: 本單元沿實際行走面布點量測，對照設備遮影與轉彎處的方向辨識而非只查燈具數量。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「步道照度與暗區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同
本單元沿實際行走面布點量測，對照設備遮影與轉彎處的方向辨識而非只查燈具數量。

Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
Measure along the actual walking surface, examining equipment shadows and direction recognition at turns instead of merely counting luminaires.

steps.title: 步道照度與暗區：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Walkway illuminance and dark zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 緊急照明能量：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元以固定照明負載估算續航，再分別檢查啟動壓降與老化，使能量和電壓兩種限制都可見。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「緊急照明能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate duration at a fixed lighting load, then separately check startup sag and ageing so both energy and voltage limits remain visible. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Emergency-lighting energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 緊急照明能量：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Emergency-lighting energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。以「緊急照明能量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulation at exit service points” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元記錄出口前的到達與通過人數，將不可立即離開的人保留在區內存量以維持守恆。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出口服務積壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record arrivals and passages at the exit, retaining people unable to leave immediately in internal occupancy to preserve conservation. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accumulation at exit service points” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。

knowledge.title: 出口服務積壓
knowledge.text: 本單元記錄出口前的到達與通過人數，將不可立即離開的人保留在區內存量以維持守恆。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。
knowledge.textEn: Record arrivals and passages at the exit, retaining people unable to leave immediately in internal occupancy to preserve conservation. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出口服務積壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accumulation at exit service points" is correct?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元記錄出口前的到達與通過人數，將不可立即離開的人保留在區內存量以維持守恆。
optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Record arrivals and passages at the exit, retaining people unable to leave immediately in internal occupancy to preserve conservation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元記錄出口前的到達與通過人數，將不可立即離開的人保留在區內存量以維持守恆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Record arrivals and passages at the exit, retaining people unable to leave immediately in internal occupancy to preserve conservation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出口服務積壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accumulation at exit service points: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口服務積壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accumulation at exit service points” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出口服務積壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accumulation at exit service points: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口服務積壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accumulation at exit service points” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「出口服務積壓」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulation at exit service points, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「出口服務積壓」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulation at exit service points, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出口服務積壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Accumulation at exit service points"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出口服務積壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accumulation at exit service points: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出口服務積壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accumulation at exit service points” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「出口服務積壓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation at exit service points. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「出口服務積壓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation at exit service points. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出口服務積壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accumulation at exit service points" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows.
quiz.explanation: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 協助需求路徑案例與受控演練證據安排
stages.titleEn: Route cases for assistance needs & Evidence planning for controlled exercises

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Route cases for assistance needs" and "Evidence planning for controlled exercises": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 協助需求路徑案例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Route cases for assistance needs: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「協助需求路徑案例」如何影響鐵路隧道疏散步道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Route cases for assistance needs” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以不同視覺、行動及溝通需求檢查路徑，將協助裝備與人員抵達時間列入情境。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「協助需求路徑案例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check routes for different vision, mobility and communication needs, including arrival times for assistance equipment and staff. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Route cases for assistance needs” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「協助需求路徑案例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Route cases for assistance needs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 受控演練證據安排：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evidence planning for controlled exercises: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受控演練證據安排」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evidence planning for controlled exercises” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「受控演練證據安排」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For evidence planning for controlled exercises, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「受控演練證據安排」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for evidence planning for controlled exercises, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
