optionsEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 場站整合試驗工時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Terminal integration-test effort: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「場站整合試驗工時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Terminal integration-test effort” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「場站整合試驗工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for terminal integration-test effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「場站整合試驗工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for terminal integration-test effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「場站整合試驗工時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Terminal integration-test effort" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。
總起重能力足夠就能保證每個吊點都不會超載
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort.
Adequate total lifting capacity guarantees that no individual support is overloaded.
quiz.explanation: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路連續焊軌應變監測
titleEn: Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail
summary: 本課聚焦以溫度補償和獨立基準追蹤連續焊軌應變。從完全拘束的熱應力量級建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把隨機量測不確定度與溫度與應變時間對齊連成可驗證的介面，最後以監測校驗與追溯計畫整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies temperature compensation and independent references for continuous-welded-rail strain. Start with thermal stress under full restraint to define physical or information boundaries, connect random measurement uncertainty with aligning temperature and strain records as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through calibration effort and traceability. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究完全拘束的熱應力量級。原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。公式 y=E*alpha*dT，代入得 y=63 MPa。邊界：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。敏感度只改 dT=25 至 27.5 K，輸出變為 69.3 MPa；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究自由伸長對照試件：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate thermal stress under full restraint. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K. Formula y=E*alpha*dT gives y=63 MPa. Boundary: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. For sensitivity, change only dT=25 to 27.5 K; the output becomes 69.3 MPa. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate free-expansion reference specimen: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級與自由伸長對照試件
stages.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint & Free-expansion reference specimen
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「完全拘束的熱應力量級」與「自由伸長對照試件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal stress under full restraint" and "Free-expansion reference specimen": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal stress under full restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。完全軸向拘束的熱應力大小由彈性模數、膨脹係數與溫差相乘得到，加熱時是壓應力。實際鋼軌可能滑移並透過扣件與道床重新分配作用；量得總應變必須分離熱應變與機械應變，才能推論應力。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全拘束的熱應力量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision. The magnitude of thermal stress under complete axial restraint is modulus times expansion coefficient times temperature change; heating produces compression. Real rail can slip and redistribute force through fasteners and ballast. Total measured strain must be separated into thermal and mechanical components before inferring stress. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal stress under full restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal stress under full restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級
knowledge.text: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。再比較完全拘束模型與可滑移現場的差異，避免把簡化量級當成挫屈判定。
knowledge.textEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. Compare full restraint with possible field slip without treating this scale calculation as a buckling decision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全拘束的熱應力量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal stress under full restraint" is correct?
options: 任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力
先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
optionsEn: Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress.
Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 先把鋼軌的無應力溫度與當前溫度分開，標明加熱時壓應力的方向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate stress-free and current rail temperatures and identify compression during heating. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal stress under full restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：彈性模數 E=210000 MPa；線膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；相對無應力溫差 dT=25 K。公式 y=E*alpha*dT，代入得 y=63 MPa。邊界：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: Young modulus E=210000 MPa; thermal expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; change from stress-free temperature dT=25 K. Formula y=E*alpha*dT gives y=63 MPa. Boundary: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全拘束的熱應力量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal stress under full restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測軌溫與應變，使用獨立參考方法或已知拘束試件檢查溫度補償與零點。以「完全拘束的熱應力量級」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record rail temperature and strain together and use an independent reference or known-restraint specimen to check thermal compensation and zero. For thermal stress under full restraint, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把相對無應力溫差 dT 從 25 改成 27.5 K（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 63 變為 69.3 MPa。先說明「完全拘束的熱應力量級」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

steps.title: 完全拘束的熱應力量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal stress under full restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal stress under full restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總應變直接乘彈性模數可能把自由熱膨脹誤當機械應力，感測器脫膠則會低估變化。回到「完全拘束的熱應力量級」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total strain by modulus can misinterpret free thermal expansion as mechanical stress; sensor debonding can suppress the response. Trace the input chain for thermal stress under full restraint. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線彈性、單軸完全拘束且均勻溫升；未分析軌道挫屈或接頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear-elastic fully restrained uniaxial uniform heating; track buckling and joints are not analysed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何溫度造成的總應變都可以直接乘彈性模數求應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any total thermally induced strain can be multiplied directly by modulus to obtain stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完全拘束的熱應力量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把總應變直接乘彈性模數可能把自由熱膨脹誤當機械應力，感測器脫膠則會低估變化。
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力

Multiplying total strain by modulus can misinterpret free thermal expansion as mechanical stress; sensor debonding can suppress the response.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying total strain by modulus can misinterpret free thermal expansion as mechanical stress; sensor debonding can suppress the response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 自由伸長對照試件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-expansion reference specimen: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由伸長對照試件」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-expansion reference specimen” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以同材質自由試件建立溫差對伸長的基準，再對照受拘束鋼軌的反應。端點位移很小可能意味拘束增加，不代表沒有熱作用。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由伸長對照試件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an unrestrained specimen of the same material to establish expansion versus temperature before comparing restrained rail. Small end movement may indicate stronger restraint rather than absent thermal action. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-expansion reference specimen” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由伸長對照試件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-expansion reference specimen”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Use an unrestrained specimen of the same material to establish expansion versus temperature before comparing restrained rail. Small end movement may indicate stronger restraint rather than absent thermal action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由伸長對照試件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-expansion reference specimen” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由伸長對照試件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-expansion reference specimen: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由伸長對照試件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-expansion reference specimen” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「自由伸長對照試件」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For free-expansion reference specimen, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把構件長度 L 從 30 改成 33 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 7.2 變為 7.92 mm。先說明「自由伸長對照試件」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only member length L from 30 to 33 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 7.2 to 7.92 mm. Explain the causal direction for free-expansion reference specimen, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 自由伸長對照試件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-expansion reference specimen: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由伸長對照試件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-expansion reference specimen” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「自由伸長對照試件」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for free-expansion reference specimen. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for free-expansion reference specimen. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
橋路輸出變化一定全都來自被測鋼軌的機械應變

Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain.
A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension.

quiz.explanationEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 橋路輸出與機械應變與隨機量測不確定度
stages.titleEn: Bridge output and mechanical strain & Random measurement uncertainty
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋路輸出與機械應變」與「隨機量測不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge output and mechanical strain" and "Random measurement uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋路輸出與機械應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge output and mechanical strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋路輸出與機械應變」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge output and mechanical strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在溫度補償後才把機械應變帶入四分之一橋的小訊號式，並保留激勵電壓紀錄。以分流校驗核對量測鏈，避免將放大器漂移當成鋼軌應力改變。四分之一橋路的小訊號輸出與激勵、應變規係數及應變成正比。導線電阻、溫度與黏貼品質都會改變零點或靈敏度；量測微小訊號時，需要分開檢查橋路、放大器和構件本身，避免把儀器漂移當成鋼軌應變。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：理想四分之一橋小應變近似，輸入已是分離後的機械應變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋路輸出與機械應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insert mechanical strain into the small-signal quarter-bridge relation only after thermal compensation and retain excitation records. Use shunt calibration to distinguish measurement-chain drift from rail-stress change. Small-signal quarter-bridge output is proportional to excitation, gauge factor and strain. Lead resistance, temperature and bonding affect zero and sensitivity. Small-signal measurement requires separate checks of bridge, amplifier and structure so instrument drift is not mistaken for rail strain. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal small-strain quarter bridge with already separated mechanical strain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge output and mechanical strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：機械應變 strain=400 microstrain；應變規係數 GF=2.1 1；橋路激勵 V=5 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mechanical strain strain=400 microstrain; gauge factor GF=2.1 1; bridge excitation V=5 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋路輸出變化一定全都來自被測鋼軌的機械應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋路輸出與機械應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge output and mechanical strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋路輸出與機械應變
knowledge.text: 在溫度補償後才把機械應變帶入四分之一橋的小訊號式，並保留激勵電壓紀錄。以分流校驗核對量測鏈，避免將放大器漂移當成鋼軌應力改變。
knowledge.textEn: Insert mechanical strain into the small-signal quarter-bridge relation only after thermal compensation and retain excitation records. Use shunt calibration to distinguish measurement-chain drift from rail-stress change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋路輸出變化一定全都來自被測鋼軌的機械應變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋路輸出與機械應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge output and mechanical strain" is correct?
options: 在溫度補償後才把機械應變帶入四分之一橋的小訊號式，並保留激勵電壓紀錄。
橋路輸出變化一定全都來自被測鋼軌的機械應變
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Insert mechanical strain into the small-signal quarter-bridge relation only after thermal compensation and retain excitation records.
Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 在溫度補償後才把機械應變帶入四分之一橋的小訊號式，並保留激勵電壓紀錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Insert mechanical strain into the small-signal quarter-bridge relation only after thermal compensation and retain excitation records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋路輸出與機械應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge output and mechanical strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋路輸出與機械應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge output and mechanical strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：機械應變 strain=400 microstrain；應變規係數 GF=2.1 1；橋路激勵 V=5 V。公式 y=V*GF*strain*1e-6/4*1000，代入得 y=1.05 mV。邊界：理想四分之一橋小應變近似，輸入已是分離後的機械應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mechanical strain strain=400 microstrain; gauge factor GF=2.1 1; bridge excitation V=5 V. Formula y=V*GF*strain*1e-6/4*1000 gives y=1.05 mV. Boundary: Ideal small-strain quarter bridge with already separated mechanical strain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用電阻分流校驗核對整條量測鏈，再以無載溫度循環檢查表觀應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a shunt calibration to check the complete measurement chain, then an unloaded thermal cycle to examine apparent strain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：機械應變 strain=400 microstrain；應變規係數 GF=2.1 1；橋路激勵 V=5 V。公式 y=V*GF*strain*1e-6/4*1000，代入得 y=1.05 mV。邊界：理想四分之一橋小應變近似，輸入已是分離後的機械應變。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mechanical strain strain=400 microstrain; gauge factor GF=2.1 1; bridge excitation V=5 V. Formula y=V*GF*strain*1e-6/4*1000 gives y=1.05 mV. Boundary: Ideal small-strain quarter bridge with already separated mechanical strain.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 用電阻分流校驗核對整條量測鏈，再以無載溫度循環檢查表觀應變。以「橋路輸出與機械應變」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Explain the causal direction for bridge output and mechanical strain, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 橋路輸出與機械應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bridge output and mechanical strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋路輸出與機械應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bridge output and mechanical strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 激勵電壓漂移會按比例改變輸出，黏貼層鬆脫則可能讓訊號幅度下降而噪音增加。回到「橋路輸出與機械應變」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excitation drift scales output, while a failing bond can reduce response amplitude and increase noise. Trace the input chain for bridge output and mechanical strain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：理想四分之一橋小應變近似，輸入已是分離後的機械應變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Ideal small-strain quarter bridge with already separated mechanical strain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋路輸出變化一定全都來自被測鋼軌的機械應變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every bridge-output change necessarily comes from mechanical rail strain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Excitation drift scales output, while a failing bond can reduce response amplitude and increase noise.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.

quiz.explanationEn: Excitation drift scales output, while a failing bond can reduce response amplitude and increase noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 隨機量測不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Random measurement uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隨機量測不確定度」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Random measurement uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先辨認哪些誤差具有獨立重複量測依據，再合成標準差。固定溫度偏差與共同基準偏移另列，不能藉平方和開根號把它們縮小。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機應變標準差，不包含共同溫度偏差或無應力溫度的不確定度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隨機量測不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Identify errors supported by independent repeat measurements before combining standard deviations. Keep fixed temperature bias and shared-reference offsets separate rather than reducing them through root-sum-square arithmetic. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random strain standard deviations, excluding common temperature bias and uncertainty in stress-free temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Random measurement uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立應變通道一標準差 s1=3 microstrain；獨立應變通道二標準差 s2=4 microstrain。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent strain standard deviation s1=3 microstrain; second independent strain standard deviation s2=4 microstrain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隨機量測不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Random measurement uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隨機量測不確定度
knowledge.text: 先辨認哪些誤差具有獨立重複量測依據，再合成標準差。固定溫度偏差與共同基準偏移另列，不能藉平方和開根號把它們縮小。
knowledge.textEn: Identify errors supported by independent repeat measurements before combining standard deviations. Keep fixed temperature bias and shared-reference offsets separate rather than reducing them through root-sum-square arithmetic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隨機量測不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Random measurement uncertainty" is correct?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
先辨認哪些誤差具有獨立重複量測依據，再合成標準差。
同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Identify errors supported by independent repeat measurements before combining standard deviations.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
quiz.explanation: 先辨認哪些誤差具有獨立重複量測依據，再合成標準差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify errors supported by independent repeat measurements before combining standard deviations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隨機量測不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Random measurement uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隨機量測不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Random measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立應變通道一標準差 s1=3 microstrain；獨立應變通道二標準差 s2=4 microstrain。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 microstrain。邊界：獨立隨機應變標準差，不包含共同溫度偏差或無應力溫度的不確定度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent strain standard deviation s1=3 microstrain; second independent strain standard deviation s2=4 microstrain. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 microstrain. Boundary: Independent random strain standard deviations, excluding common temperature bias and uncertainty in stress-free temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 microstrain. Boundary: Independent random strain standard deviations, excluding common temperature bias and uncertainty in stress-free temperature.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instructionEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only first independent strain standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 microstrain (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 microstrain. Explain the causal direction for random measurement uncertainty, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For random measurement uncertainty, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立應變通道一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 microstrain（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 microstrain。先說明「隨機量測不確定度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only first independent strain standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 microstrain (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 microstrain. Explain the causal direction for random measurement uncertainty, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隨機量測不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Random measurement uncertainty"?

optionsEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隨機量測不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Random measurement uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隨機量測不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Random measurement uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「隨機量測不確定度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for random measurement uncertainty. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

steps.title: 感測位置與測量基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sensor positions and survey datums: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「感測位置與測量基準」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sensor positions and survey datums” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應變事件需要能回到同一鋼軌位置，長視線的角度誤差會放大定位差。以不同站點閉合核對位置，避免重複讀值一致卻共同使用偏移的基準。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「感測位置與測量基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strain events must map back to the same rail location, and angular error grows with sight distance. Check positions from independent stations so repeatability cannot hide a displaced shared datum. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sensor positions and survey datums” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「感測位置與測量基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 感測位置與測量基準：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測位置與測量基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor positions and survey datums” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Convert inspection-vehicle speed and sampling rate into spacing while distinguishing fixed gauges from this moving assumption. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高頻振動混疊成低頻漂移可能被誤判為幾何偏差，遺失時間戳也會破壞空間重建。回到「移動檢測的空間取樣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for spatial sampling during mobile inspection. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「移動檢測的空間取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.

stages.title: 溫度與應變時間對齊與季節與拘束狀態案例
stages.titleEn: Aligning temperature and strain records & Seasonal and restraint-state cases
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度與應變時間對齊」與「季節與拘束狀態案例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aligning temperature and strain records" and "Seasonal and restraint-state cases": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度與應變時間對齊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aligning temperature and strain records: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度與應變時間對齊」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aligning temperature and strain records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軌溫與應變若不同步，日照快速改變時可能形成假的相位或遲滯。用共同時間基準核對漂移，再判斷曲線差異是否來自真實材料與拘束反應。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度與應變時間對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized temperature and strain can create false phase shifts during rapid solar heating. Check clock drift before attributing curve differences to material or restraint behaviour. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aligning temperature and strain records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度與應變時間對齊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aligning temperature and strain records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度與應變時間對齊
knowledge.text: 軌溫與應變若不同步，日照快速改變時可能形成假的相位或遲滯。用共同時間基準核對漂移，再判斷曲線差異是否來自真實材料與拘束反應。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized temperature and strain can create false phase shifts during rapid solar heating. Check clock drift before attributing curve differences to material or restraint behaviour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度與應變時間對齊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

軌溫與應變若不同步，日照快速改變時可能形成假的相位或遲滯。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Unsynchronized temperature and strain can create false phase shifts during rapid solar heating.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized temperature and strain can create false phase shifts during rapid solar heating. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度與應變時間對齊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aligning temperature and strain records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫度與應變時間對齊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aligning temperature and strain records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。

Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度與應變時間對齊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Aligning temperature and strain records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度與應變時間對齊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aligning temperature and strain records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「溫度與應變時間對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning temperature and strain records, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for aligning temperature and strain records, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Limits of anomaly-free data: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「零異常資料的推論界限」如何影響鐵路連續焊軌應變監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Limits of anomaly-free data” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strain monitoring of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續紀錄多筆資料常具有時間相關性，不能直接當成相同數量的獨立試驗。先定義獨立採樣單位，再解讀零異常的上界，不由此宣告鋼軌絕對安全。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「零異常資料的推論界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Consecutive samples are often correlated and cannot automatically count as independent trials. Define independent sampling units before interpreting an anomaly-free bound, without declaring unconditional rail safety. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of anomaly-free data” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「零異常資料的推論界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of anomaly-free data”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 零異常資料的推論界限
knowledge.text: 連續紀錄多筆資料常具有時間相關性，不能直接當成相同數量的獨立試驗。先定義獨立採樣單位，再解讀零異常的上界，不由此宣告鋼軌絕對安全。
knowledge.textEn: Consecutive samples are often correlated and cannot automatically count as independent trials. Define independent sampling units before interpreting an anomaly-free bound, without declaring unconditional rail safety.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「零異常資料的推論界限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Limits of anomaly-free data" is correct?
options: 連續紀錄多筆資料常具有時間相關性，不能直接當成相同數量的獨立試驗。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
optionsEn: Consecutive samples are often correlated and cannot automatically count as independent trials.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
quiz.explanation: 連續紀錄多筆資料常具有時間相關性，不能直接當成相同數量的獨立試驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Consecutive samples are often correlated and cannot automatically count as independent trials. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 零異常資料的推論界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Limits of anomaly-free data: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「零異常資料的推論界限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Limits of anomaly-free data” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「零異常資料的推論界限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Limits of anomaly-free data", which statement holds?
options: 量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 零異常資料的推論界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Limits of anomaly-free data: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「零異常資料的推論界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Limits of anomaly-free data” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「零異常資料的推論界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For limits of anomaly-free data, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「零異常資料的推論界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for limits of anomaly-free data, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「零異常資料的推論界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For limits of anomaly-free data, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
