quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale check of guideway bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。以「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. For scale check of guideway bending, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把簡支跨度 L 從 20 改成 22 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.761905 變為 1.0141 mm。先說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only simply supported span L from 20 to 22 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.761905 to 1.0141 mm. Explain the causal direction for scale check of guideway bending, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。以「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. For scale check of guideway bending, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把簡支跨度 L 從 20 改成 22 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.761905 變為 1.0141 mm。先說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only simply supported span L from 20 to 22 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.761905 to 1.0141 mm. Explain the causal direction for scale check of guideway bending, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scale check of guideway bending"?
options: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小
optionsEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.
quiz.explanation: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale check of guideway bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。回到「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. Trace the input chain for scale check of guideway bending. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。回到「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. Trace the input chain for scale check of guideway bending. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scale check of guideway bending" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。
導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear.
Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur.
quiz.explanation: 未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。以成對高程量測檢查扭轉，區分剛體轉動、支承沉陷與截面變形。偏心輪載會扭轉導梁，扭角由扭矩、長度與扭轉剛度控制。兩側輪道相對高差會影響導向輪接觸，即使跨中垂直撓度很小仍可能存在明顯扭轉；開口截面與翹曲拘束的行為不能用單純圓軸公式概括。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. Use paired elevation measurements to distinguish twist, rigid rotation and support settlement. Eccentric wheel loading twists a guideway, with angle governed by torque, length and torsional rigidity. Relative rail-surface height affects guide-wheel contact even when vertical deflection is small. Open sections and restrained warping cannot be represented fully by a simple shaft analogy. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉
knowledge.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist
knowledge.text: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。以成對高程量測檢查扭轉，區分剛體轉動、支承沉陷與截面變形。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. Use paired elevation measurements to distinguish twist, rigid rotation and support settlement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist" is correct?
options: 導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉
速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍
跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。
optionsEn: Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection.
quiz.explanation: 跨座車輛偏心載重會使導梁兩側產生相對轉角，即使中心線撓度仍小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。公式 y=T*L/(G*J)*1000，代入得 y=0.428571 mrad。邊界：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4. Formula y=T*L/(G*J)*1000 gives y=0.428571 mrad. Boundary: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。公式 y=T*L/(G*J)*1000，代入得 y=0.428571 mrad。邊界：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4. Formula y=T*L/(G*J)*1000 gives y=0.428571 mrad. Boundary: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。
同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
幾何最大誤差一樣時所有波長的乘坐影響一定一樣
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
Equal maximum geometry error gives identical ride effects at every wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: torque T=120000 N*m; member length L=15 m; shear modulus G=1.4e+10 Pa; equivalent torsion constant J=0.3 m4. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。以「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison. For eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把扭矩 T 從 120000 改成 132000 N*m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.428571 變為 0.471429 mrad。先說明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only torque T from 120000 to 132000 N*m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.428571 to 0.471429 mrad. Explain the causal direction for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。以「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison. For eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把扭矩 T 從 120000 改成 132000 N*m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.428571 變為 0.471429 mrad。先說明「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only torque T from 120000 to 132000 N*m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.428571 to 0.471429 mrad. Explain the causal direction for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
quiz.explanation: 在兩側同斷面量高程差，將剛體轉動與支承沉陷分離，再比較偏心載重方向反轉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure opposite-side elevations at common sections, separate rigid rotation and settlement, and reverse eccentric loading for comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 偏心輪載與導梁扭轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。回到「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Trace the input chain for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。回到「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Trace the input chain for eccentric wheel loads and beam twist. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍
只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle.
quiz.explanation: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 曲線速度與側向需求與導梁伸縮與支承活動
stages.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand & Thermal movement and support travel
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲線速度與側向需求」與「導梁伸縮與支承活動」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curve speed and lateral demand" and "Thermal movement and support travel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲線速度與側向需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curve speed and lateral demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲線速度與側向需求」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curve speed and lateral demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將曲線半徑和車速換成側向加速度量級，觀察車速平方的影響。導向輪力仍取決於車體和懸吊分配，不可把集中質點結果直接當成單輪荷載。曲線向心加速度與速度平方成正比、與半徑成反比，導向輪與懸吊需共同提供相應作用。傾斜或超高可改變乘客感受的側向分量，但不會消除車輛轉彎所需的向心加速度；轉折處的變化率亦影響舒適。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲線速度與側向需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Centripetal acceleration scales with speed squared and inverse radius, supplied through guidance and suspension forces. Tilt or banking changes the lateral component felt by passengers but does not remove the acceleration needed to turn. Its rate of change through transitions also affects comfort. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry. steps.title: 曲線速度與側向需求：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲線速度與側向需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curve speed and lateral demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：速度 v=12 m/s；曲線半徑 R=150 m。公式 y=v*v/R，代入得 y=0.96 m/s2。邊界：平面定速圓曲線，不含超高、傾斜與過渡曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: speed v=12 m/s; curve radius R=150 m. Formula y=v*v/R gives y=0.96 m/s2. Boundary: Constant-speed planar circular curve, excluding cant, tilt and transition geometry. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較速度、曲率及車體側向加速度，先轉換感測器座標再討論乘坐感受。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized speed, curvature and body lateral acceleration after transforming sensor coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 同步比較速度、曲率及車體側向加速度，先轉換感測器座標再討論乘坐感受。以「曲線速度與側向需求」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 導梁伸縮與支承活動：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and support travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導梁伸縮與支承活動」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal movement and support travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先用自由伸長估計均勻溫差下的位移需求，再比較固定與活動支承如何改變反應。日照熱梯度和支承卡滯不在此簡式內，須另保留量測證據。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁伸縮與支承活動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate uniform-temperature free movement before comparing fixed and sliding support responses. Solar gradients and seized bearings lie outside the simple relation and need separate measurement evidence. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and support travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導梁伸縮與支承活動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal movement and support travel" is correct?
options: 量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
先用自由伸長估計均勻溫差下的位移需求，再比較固定與活動支承如何改變反應。

optionsEn: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
Estimate uniform-temperature free movement before comparing fixed and sliding support responses.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.

steps.title: 導梁伸縮與支承活動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and support travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal movement and support travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K. Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 導梁伸縮與支承活動：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and support travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁伸縮與支承活動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal movement and support travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「導梁伸縮與支承活動」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. For thermal movement and support travel, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把構件長度 L 從 30 改成 33 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 7.2 變為 7.92 mm。先說明「導梁伸縮與支承活動」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only member length L from 30 to 33 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 7.2 to 7.92 mm. Explain the causal direction for thermal movement and support travel, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。以「導梁伸縮與支承活動」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For thermal movement and support travel, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. quiz.question: 要驗證「導梁伸縮與支承活動」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement and support travel"?
options: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection.
quiz.explanation: 以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導梁伸縮與支承活動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and support travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal movement and support travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for thermal movement and support travel. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。回到「導梁伸縮與支承活動」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Trace the input chain for thermal movement and support travel. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導梁伸縮與支承活動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement and support travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。
同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension.
Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position.
quiz.explanation: 支承卡住可能讓位移很小但內力增加，日照溫差又可能造成彎曲而非單純伸長。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A seized support can suppress movement while increasing force; solar gradients may cause bending rather than simple extension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 導向面幾何控制網與幾何量測隨機成分
stages.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces & Random components of geometry measurement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導向面幾何控制網」與「幾何量測隨機成分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey control for guide surfaces" and "Random components of geometry measurement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導向面幾何控制網：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey control for guide surfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導向面幾何控制網」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey control for guide surfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。以閉合觀測檢查基準一致性，不用單站重複性代替全線準確度。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導向面幾何控制網」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance. Use closure checks rather than substituting repeated readings at one station for network accuracy. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey control for guide surfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導向面幾何控制網」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey control for guide surfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。以閉合觀測檢查基準一致性，不用單站重複性代替全線準確度。
knowledge.textEn: Tie contact guide surfaces reproducibly to the control network because angular error grows with sight distance. Use closure checks rather than substituting repeated readings at one station for network accuracy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導向面幾何控制網」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey control for guide surfaces" is correct?
options: 同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
車輛接觸的導向面必須與控制網建立可重複的幾何關係，長視線會放大角度誤差。

steps.title: 導梁波長與行車激振：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「導梁波長與行車激振」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guideway wavelength and running excitation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同幾何波長在不同車速下形成不同時間頻率，因此只看最大偏差會漏掉動態資訊。將量測波長與車速並列，找出需要車輛模型進一步分析的組合。固定空間波長在移動車輛上轉換成時間激振頻率，因此同一幾何不平順在不同速度下可能接近不同振動模態。只看最大偏差會漏掉波長資訊；導梁精度控制需要把幾何頻譜、車速與車輛動態連結，而非只追求單點誤差最小。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速通過單一正弦空間成分，未計車輛傳遞函數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁波長與行車激振」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same geometric wavelength produces different temporal frequencies at different speeds, so peak deviation alone misses dynamic information. Pair wavelength with speed to identify combinations needing a vehicle-response model. A spatial wavelength becomes a temporal excitation frequency on a moving vehicle, so the same geometry can excite different modes at different speeds. Maximum deviation alone loses wavelength information. Guideway precision therefore links geometry spectra, speed and vehicle dynamics rather than only minimizing point errors. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed passage over one sinusoidal spatial component; the vehicle transfer function is not included. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Guideway wavelength and running excitation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 導梁波長與行車激振：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁波長與行車激振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Guideway wavelength and running excitation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將幾何資料按里程頻譜分析，再用速度轉換頻率，與車上加速度頻譜比較。以「導梁波長與行車激振」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse geometry by spatial frequency, transform using speed, and compare with onboard acceleration spectra. For guideway wavelength and running excitation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把運行速度 speed 從 40 改成 44 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 2.2 Hz。先說明「導梁波長與行車激振」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only running speed speed from 40 to 44 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 2.2 Hz. Explain the causal direction for guideway wavelength and running excitation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：里程軸不均勻會扭曲頻譜，忽略車輛模態又可能把所有波長視為同樣重要。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven distance sampling distorts spectra; ignoring vehicle modes incorrectly treats every wavelength as equally important. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Guideway wavelength and running excitation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 里程軸不均勻會扭曲頻譜，忽略車輛模態又可能把所有波長視為同樣重要。回到「導梁波長與行車激振」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven distance sampling distorts spectra; ignoring vehicle modes incorrectly treats every wavelength as equally important. Trace the input chain for guideway wavelength and running excitation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速通過單一正弦空間成分，未計車輛傳遞函數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed passage over one sinusoidal spatial component; the vehicle transfer function is not included.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal maximum geometry error gives identical ride effects at every wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 剛度質量與模態概念：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剛度質量與模態概念」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先用單自由度模型理解剛度和質量如何改變固有頻率，再比較來自導梁幾何的激振。模型沒有阻尼與多模態，不能只憑頻率相近就估計真實放大量。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剛度質量與模態概念」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use one degree of freedom to understand stiffness and mass effects before comparing guideway excitation. With damping and multiple modes absent, frequency proximity alone cannot determine actual amplification. A single-degree natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. Stiffening can move away from one excitation yet toward another. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剛度質量與模態概念」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剛度質量與模態概念
knowledge.text: 先用單自由度模型理解剛度和質量如何改變固有頻率，再比較來自導梁幾何的激振。模型沒有阻尼與多模態，不能只憑頻率相近就估計真實放大量。
knowledge.textEn: Use one degree of freedom to understand stiffness and mass effects before comparing guideway excitation. With damping and multiple modes absent, frequency proximity alone cannot determine actual amplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剛度質量與模態概念」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation" is correct?
options: 結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小

先用單自由度模型理解剛度和質量如何改變固有頻率，再比較來自導梁幾何的激振。
optionsEn: A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Use one degree of freedom to understand stiffness and mass effects before comparing guideway excitation.
quiz.explanation: 先用單自由度模型理解剛度和質量如何改變固有頻率，再比較來自導梁幾何的激振。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use one degree of freedom to understand stiffness and mass effects before comparing guideway excitation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剛度質量與模態概念：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剛度質量與模態概念」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stiffness, mass and modal interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Boundary: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用低能量掃頻或自由衰減試驗量頻率與阻尼，對照載重改變後的模態移動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure frequency and damping with low-energy sweep or free decay, then compare modal shifts after changing load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：等效剛度 k=1.8e+06 N/m；等效質量 m=12000 kg。公式 y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)，代入得 y=1.94924 Hz。邊界：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent stiffness k=1.8e+06 N/m; equivalent mass m=12000 kg. Formula y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi) gives y=1.94924 Hz. Boundary: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 導梁車輛與月台界面：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「導梁車輛與月台界面」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將導梁位置、懸吊移動和月台測量放到同一間隙預算，避免土建與車輛各自合格卻介面衝突。明確區分有界容差與隨機標準差，不能互換合成方法。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁車輛與月台界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine guideway position, suspension movement and platform survey in one gap budget to expose interface conflicts between separately acceptable disciplines. Distinguish bounded tolerances from random standard deviations when combining them. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Guideway, vehicle and platform interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎扭溫度整合案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「彎扭溫度整合案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for combined bending, torsion and temperature cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for combined bending, torsion and temperature cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「彎扭溫度整合案例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Combined bending, torsion and temperature cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 懸掛式單軌轉轍系統
summary: 本課聚焦懸掛轉轍的承載路徑機構定位與鎖定證據。從可動構件力行程帳建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把致動推力與獨立保持與動作回授的事件次序連成可驗證的介面，最後以維修恢復與服務條件整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies load paths, positioning and locking evidence in suspended-monorail switches. Start with force-travel work of moving members to define physical or information boundaries, connect actuation thrust and independent holding with event ordering in actuator feedback as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through maintenance recovery and service conditions. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究可動構件力行程帳。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：準靜態剛性連桿力矩，不包含實際懸掛式轉轍構造、動態衝擊或額定設計。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate force-travel work of moving members. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate switch-linkage lever arm and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Quasistatic rigid-link torque, excluding actual suspended-switch construction, impact dynamics and rated design. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 可動構件力行程帳與轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩
stages.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members & Switch-linkage lever arm and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可動構件力行程帳」與「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force-travel work of moving members" and "Switch-linkage lever arm and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可動構件力行程帳」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force-travel work of moving members” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可動構件力行程帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force-travel work of moving members” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可動構件力行程帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Force-travel work of moving members”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可動構件力行程帳
knowledge.text: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。比較往返曲線的差異，找出摩擦或對位偏差可能出現的行程位置。
knowledge.textEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. Compare forward and reverse curves to locate possible friction or alignment effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可動構件力行程帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force-travel work of moving members" is correct?
options: 致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉
用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。
馬達角度已達目標就能保證懸掛式轉轍梁定位完成
optionsEn: Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.
Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade.
The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam.
quiz.explanation: 用假想轉轍構件的力與位移建立準靜態作功，不假定其機構等同一般尖軌。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Build quasistatic work from a hypothetical moving member without equating it to a conventional switch blade. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可動構件力行程帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force-travel work of moving members” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態構件行程與定效率，不含動態衝擊或懸掛式轉轍的實際保持要求。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic member travel and fixed efficiency, excluding dynamic impact and actual suspended-switch retention requirements.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「可動構件力行程帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force-travel work of moving members", which statement holds?
options: 油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
optionsEn: A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可動構件力行程帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force-travel work of moving members: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可動構件力行程帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force-travel work of moving members” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。以「可動構件力行程帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions. For force-travel work of moving members, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把作用力 F 從 4500 改成 4950 N（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 830.769 變為 913.846 J。先說明「可動構件力行程帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only applied force F from 4500 to 4950 N (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 830.769 to 913.846 J. Explain the causal direction for force-travel work of moving members, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦增加與機構偏心都能提高能耗，但其位置依賴不同；行程結束也不等於鎖閉已被證明。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Friction and misalignment both increase energy but differ with position; reaching the end of travel does not prove locking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Switch-linkage lever arm and torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連桿接近不利幾何時所需力會提高，齒隙又可能使馬達角度改變卻沒有相應梁位移。回到「轉轍連桿力臂與轉矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unfavourable linkage geometry raises required force, while backlash can allow motor-angle change without corresponding beam displacement. Trace the input chain for switch-linkage lever arm and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The target motor angle guarantees completed positioning of a suspended switch beam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 多致動點位置差與致動推力與獨立保持
stages.titleEn: Position mismatch across actuators & Actuation thrust and independent holding
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多致動點位置差」與「致動推力與獨立保持」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position mismatch across actuators" and "Actuation thrust and independent holding": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多致動點位置差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position mismatch across actuators: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多致動點位置差」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position mismatch across actuators” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一可動梁的多個致動點若不同步，微小速度差可能累積成扭斜。以共同時基追蹤位置差和負載轉移，不把平均行程完成當成各點同時到位。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多致動點位置差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew. Track position differences and load transfer on a common clock rather than treating mean completed travel as simultaneous arrival. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position mismatch across actuators” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多致動點位置差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position mismatch across actuators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew. Track position differences and load transfer on a common clock rather than treating mean completed travel as simultaneous arrival.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多致動點位置差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Position mismatch across actuators" is correct?
