兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位
optionsEn: Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 同一可動梁的多個致動點若不同步，微小速度差可能累積成扭斜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small speed differences among actuators on one moving beam can accumulate into skew. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多致動點位置差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position mismatch across actuators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多致動點位置差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position mismatch across actuators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure both connection points simultaneously with independent displacement sensors, compare encoder zeros and linkage geometry, then compare drift slopes at low and uneven load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。以「多致動點位置差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Explain the causal direction for position mismatch across actuators, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extra friction at one end changes the mismatch slope, whereas a shared zero error can make feedback agree while the linkage is displaced from its reference. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 某端摩擦增加會造成位移差斜率改變，共同零點錯誤則可能讓兩端回授一致卻偏離機構中線。回到「多致動點位置差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Actuation thrust and independent holding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「致動推力與獨立保持」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Actuation thrust and independent holding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。將定位、保持和位置確認分開列成介面，使用隔離教具觀察摩擦與背壓。液壓推力由壓力乘有效活塞面積決定，回程側面積與背壓可能不同。壓力達標並不保證位移同步，漏油、氣泡和摩擦會改變動作；安全承載還需獨立機械保持機制與設備規定，不能只依賴壓力表。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「致動推力與獨立保持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. Separate positioning, holding and confirmation interfaces and inspect friction and back pressure on an isolated rig. Hydraulic force follows pressure times effective piston area, with different return-side area and back pressure possible. Target pressure does not guarantee synchronized movement because leakage, air and friction affect motion. Safe support also requires specified holding mechanisms rather than dependence on a pressure gauge alone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Actuation thrust and independent holding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「致動推力與獨立保持」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Actuation thrust and independent holding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path. Separate positioning, holding and confirmation interfaces and inspect friction and back pressure on an isolated rig.

knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓讀值正常就能單獨保證負載永遠保持原位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

液壓壓力乘有效面積只估算推力，不能單獨證明載車路徑已能承載。
總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變
optionsEn: A normal hydraulic pressure reading alone guarantees that the load remains fixed indefinitely.
Pressure times effective area estimates thrust but does not establish a load-bearing train path.
Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.

steps.title: 致動推力與獨立保持：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「致動推力與獨立保持」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Actuation thrust and independent holding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: hydraulic pressure p=12 MPa; piston area A=0.008 m2; force-transfer efficiency eta=0.9 1. Formula y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000 gives y=86.4 kN. Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：油壓 p=12 MPa；活塞面積 A=0.008 m2；力傳遞效率 eta=0.9 1。公式 y=p*1e6*A*eta/1000，代入得 y=86.4 kN。邊界：單一活塞準靜態推力，未含背壓、管路瞬變與額定安全係數。

Boundary: Quasistatic force of one piston; back pressure, line transients and rated safety factors are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Actuation thrust and independent holding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立力感測器核對壓力推算，並記錄停留時的位移漂移與油溫變化。以「致動推力與獨立保持」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure-derived force with an independent load cell and record displacement drift and oil temperature during holding. For actuation thrust and independent holding, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hydraulic pressure p from 12 to 13.2 MPa (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 86.4 to 95.04 kN. Explain the causal direction for actuation thrust and independent holding, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 內洩漏可造成保持位置下降但壓力讀值短時正常，空氣混入則可能使動作變軟並延遲。回到「致動推力與獨立保持」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Internal leakage can cause sag despite temporarily normal pressure, while entrained air makes motion compliant and delayed. Trace the input chain for actuation thrust and independent holding. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

stages.title: 承載位置與支點反力與位置鎖定與路徑狀態
stages.titleEn: Load position and support reactions & Position, locking and route states
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「承載位置與支點反力」與「位置鎖定與路徑狀態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load position and support reactions" and "Position, locking and route states": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 承載位置與支點反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load position and support reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「承載位置與支點反力」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load position and support reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。將可動構件自重和假想車重分列，避免以幾何中心代替實際重心。兩支承反力由力與力矩平衡同時決定。重心偏向一側時，該側反力增加而另一側減少，總和仍不變；平均反力看似充足不能掩蓋單側限制，支承接觸若脫離還會改變原先的邊界條件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「承載位置與支點反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load. Separate moving-member weight from hypothetical vehicle weight and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity. Two support reactions follow both force and moment equilibrium. Moving the centre of gravity toward one support raises that reaction while reducing the other without changing the total. Adequate mean reaction cannot hide a local limit, and loss of contact changes the assumed boundary conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load position and support reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「承載位置與支點反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load position and support reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 承載位置與支點反力
knowledge.text: 在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。將可動構件自重和假想車重分列，避免以幾何中心代替實際重心。
knowledge.textEn: Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load. Separate moving-member weight from hypothetical vehicle weight and distinguish geometric centre from centre of gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總重量不變時左右支承的載重也一定不變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「承載位置與支點反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

在兩支承教學模型中移動偏心載重，觀察反力如何重新分配而總和不變。
optionsEn: Unchanged total weight guarantees unchanged load at each support.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Move an eccentric load in a two-support teaching model and observe reaction redistribution at constant total load.

steps.title: 承載位置與支點反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load position and support reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「承載位置與支點反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load position and support reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: total load W=200 kN; support spacing L=4 m; centre-of-gravity eccentricity e=0.4 m. Formula y=W*(0.5+e/L) gives y=120 kN. Boundary: Rigid body on two simple supports that remain in contact, neglecting dynamic swing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：總載重 W=200 kN；支承間距 L=4 m；重心偏心 e=0.4 m。公式 y=W*(0.5+e/L)，代入得 y=120 kN。邊界：剛體兩簡支靜力模型且兩支承保持接觸，忽略動態擺動。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 承載位置與支點反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load position and support reactions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「承載位置與支點反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load position and support reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩反力之和與各自力矩，再以已知小偏心移動驗證量測方向與零點。以「承載位置與支點反力」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the reaction sum and moments, then apply a known small eccentricity to verify sensor direction and zero. For load position and support reactions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把重心偏心 e 從 0.4 改成 0.44 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變為 122 kN。先說明「承載位置與支點反力」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for load position and support reactions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把幾何中心當成重心會錯估分力，支承沉陷或接觸鬆脫又可能使靜力模型失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing geometric centre with centre of gravity misallocates load; settlement or loose contact can invalidate the static model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把動作命令、機械反應和位置回授分成獨立時間點，檢查軟體顯示是否早於實體確認。將感測更新和傳輸等待列帳，範例不作現場動作延時設定。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動作回授的事件次序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate command, mechanical response and position feedback to check whether a display precedes physical confirmation. Account for sensor updates and transmission waiting without adopting example delays as field settings. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. steps.title: 雙確認鏈共同原因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Common causes in duplicated confirmation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙確認鏈共同原因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common causes in duplicated confirmation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Common causes in duplicated confirmation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「雙確認鏈共同原因」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for common causes in duplicated confirmation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 雙確認鏈共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Common causes in duplicated confirmation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙確認鏈共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common causes in duplicated confirmation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「雙確認鏈共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in duplicated confirmation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 中止偏斜與失訊案例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「中止偏斜與失訊案例」如何影響懸掛式單軌轉轍系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suspended-monorail switch systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把正常切換、行程中止和確認失聯分成不同試驗，不以多次成功動作代表全部狀態。用離線重播追蹤每項需求，保留安全停止後的復原邊界。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「中止偏斜與失訊案例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat normal switching, interrupted travel and lost confirmation as distinct tests rather than counting repeated successful moves as full coverage. Trace requirements through offline replay and retain recovery boundaries after safe withdrawal. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interrupted, skewed and missing-feedback cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 維修恢復與服務條件：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 區分機構修復、確認鏈恢復和旅客服務恢復，三者時間點不必相同。以維修履歷比較短停與長停，避免可用度數字掩蓋仍未完成的承載或鎖定證據。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「維修恢復與服務條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish mechanism repair, confirmation recovery and passenger-service restoration because their timestamps may differ. Compare short and long outages without letting availability conceal incomplete load-path or locking evidence. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Maintenance recovery and service conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「維修恢復與服務條件」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 維修恢復與服務條件：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維修恢復與服務條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance recovery and service conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「維修恢復與服務條件」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for maintenance recovery and service conditions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

title: 磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制
summary: 本課聚焦以空間頻譜與測量不確定度控制磁浮導梁精度。從導向道測量角度誤差建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把不平順波長轉換與理想吸力模型的適用邊界連成可驗證的介面，最後以有限合格紀錄的外推整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies maglev guideway precision through spatial spectra and survey uncertainty. Start with angular error in guideway surveying to define physical or information boundaries, connect converting irregularity wavelengths with limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through extrapolating finite successful records. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究導向道測量角度誤差。原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。公式 y=distance*angle*1000，代入得 y=1 mm。邊界：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。敏感度只改 distance=40 至 44 m，輸出變為 1.1 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究精度帳的獨立與相關成分：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate angular error in guideway surveying. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad. Formula y=distance*angle*1000 gives y=1 mm. Boundary: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. For sensitivity, change only distance=40 to 44 m; the output becomes 1.1 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate independent and correlated precision terms: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導向道測量角度誤差」與「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Angular error in guideway surveying" and "Independent and correlated precision terms": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導向道測量角度誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Angular error in guideway surveying: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導向道測量角度誤差」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angular error in guideway surveying” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先由視距與微小角度誤差估算橫向偏移，辨認長視線對控制網的影響。再用獨立站點和閉合差交叉檢查，避免共同基準錯誤被重複性掩蓋。小角度方向誤差會隨視線距離放大成橫向位置誤差，長視線不一定帶來更準的幾何控制。基準網、折光、儀器對中與目標安裝都會影響結果；同一站多次讀值一致，仍可能共同受到基準偏移影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小角近似與單一方向誤差，未含完整測量網平差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導向道測量角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault. A small angular error becomes transverse position error proportional to sight distance, so a longer sight is not automatically more accurate. Control networks, refraction, centring and target mounting all matter. Repeated agreement from one station can still share a common datum error. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-angle approximation for one direction error, not a complete survey-network adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Angular error in guideway surveying” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：視線距離 distance=40 m；小角誤差 angle=2.5e-05 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sight distance distance=40 m; small angular error angle=2.5e-05 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Angular error in guideway surveying”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Estimate transverse offset from sight distance and small angular error to examine network sensitivity. Cross-check independent stations and closure so repeatability cannot hide a shared datum fault.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一站位重複量測完全一致就能保證絕對位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Identical repeated observations from one station guarantee correct absolute position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent and correlated precision terms: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent and correlated precision terms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For independent and correlated precision terms, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for independent and correlated precision terms, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.

steps.title: 精度帳的獨立與相關成分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent and correlated precision terms: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent and correlated precision terms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for independent and correlated precision terms. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for independent and correlated precision terms. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「精度帳的獨立與相關成分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent and correlated precision terms" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 導梁溫差與基準時刻與不平順波長轉換
stages.titleEn: Guideway temperature and reference epoch & Converting irregularity wavelengths
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導梁溫差與基準時刻」與「不平順波長轉換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Guideway temperature and reference epoch" and "Converting irregularity wavelengths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導梁溫差與基準時刻：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Guideway temperature and reference epoch: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導梁溫差與基準時刻」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guideway temperature and reference epoch” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同時間量測的導梁可能因溫度而改變長度，先定義比較所用的參考狀態。自由均勻伸長只是基準模型，熱梯度和拘束須另外追蹤。自由熱伸長與原長、膨脹係數及溫差成正比，但受拘束後伸長會被轉成內力。接縫、支承與鄰接構件共同決定這種轉換；因此同一個溫差可能在自由端表現為位移，在固定端表現為應力，不能用一種量測代替另一種。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁溫差與基準時刻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measurements at different times may capture thermal length changes, so define the comparison reference state first. Uniform free expansion is only a baseline; gradients and restraint require separate tracking. Free thermal expansion scales with length, coefficient and temperature change, while restraint converts some expansion into force. Joints, supports and adjoining members govern that conversion. The same temperature change can produce movement at a free end and stress at a restrained end, so one measurement cannot replace the other. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Guideway temperature and reference epoch” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: member length L=30 m; expansion coefficient alpha=1.2e-05 1/K; temperature change dT=20 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導梁溫差與基準時刻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Guideway temperature and reference epoch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Measurements at different times may capture thermal length changes, so define the comparison reference state first. Uniform free expansion is only a baseline; gradients and restraint require separate tracking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導梁溫差與基準時刻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Guideway temperature and reference epoch" is correct?
options: 不同時間量測的導梁可能因溫度而改變長度，先定義比較所用的參考狀態。

steps.title: 導梁溫差與基準時刻：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Guideway temperature and reference epoch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：構件長度 L=30 m；膨脹係數 alpha=1.2e-05 1/K；溫度變化 dT=20 K。公式 y=L*alpha*dT*1000，代入得 y=7.2 mm。邊界：均勻溫度與自由伸長；不包含熱梯度引起的彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Formula y=L*alpha*dT*1000 gives y=7.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform temperature and free expansion; thermal-gradient bending is omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多點溫度檢查均勻假設，再對照端點位移與支承狀態，分辨自由與拘束行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature uniformity at several points and compare end movement with support condition to distinguish free and restrained behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 用線性單自由度彈簧質量模型理解固有頻率，並清楚標示它沒有完整磁路與控制器。再比較幾何激振的頻率位置，不由無阻尼模型推論真實乘坐加速度。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸浮系統頻率量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a linear spring-mass model to understand frequency scale while explicitly excluding full magnetic and controller dynamics. Compare excitation locations without inferring actual ride acceleration from an undamped model. A single-degree natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. Stiffening can move away from one excitation yet toward another. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency scale of a suspension model” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何檢測速度與取樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection speed and geometric sampling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高頻振動混疊成低頻漂移可能被誤判為幾何偏差，遺失時間戳也會破壞空間重建。回到「幾何檢測速度與取樣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for inspection speed and geometric sampling. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Spacing for constant speed and uniform sampling; it is not automatically the smallest resolvable defect size.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: High-frequency vibration can alias into apparent low-frequency geometry drift; missing timestamps also corrupt spatial reconstruction. Trace the input chain for inspection speed and geometric sampling. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界與幾何與車體量測時間鏈
stages.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model & Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」與「幾何與車體量測時間鏈」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model" and "Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 只用理想均勻氣隙的靜態磁壓說明磁通平方的尺度關係，不把它冒充超導電動懸浮。再指出導梁間隙誤差會透過不同磁路機制影響力，需依實際系統另建模型。簡化氣隙磁壓與磁通密度平方成正比，幾何間隙與磁路會影響可達磁通。電磁吸引與電動懸浮的機制不同，不能把這個靜態吸力式套到所有磁浮；線圈控制、飽和與動態穩定性仍需要獨立模型。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻理想氣隙的靜態磁壓，不是超導電動懸浮系統的完整力模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use ideal uniform-gap static pressure only to illustrate square-flux scaling, not superconducting electrodynamic suspension. Explain that gap errors affect force through system-specific magnetic mechanisms requiring separate models. Simplified air-gap magnetic pressure scales with flux density squared, while gap geometry and magnetic circuit govern attainable flux. Electromagnetic attraction differs from electrodynamic suspension, so this static expression does not apply to every maglev. Control, saturation and dynamic stability need separate models. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static magnetic pressure in an ideal uniform air gap, not a complete superconducting electrodynamic-suspension force model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有磁浮列車都能直接使用同一個靜態吸力公式」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every maglev train can use the same static attraction formula directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界
knowledge.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model
knowledge.text: 只用理想均勻氣隙的靜態磁壓說明磁通平方的尺度關係，不把它冒充超導電動懸浮。再指出導梁間隙誤差會透過不同磁路機制影響力，需依實際系統另建模型。
knowledge.textEn: Use ideal uniform-gap static pressure only to illustrate square-flux scaling, not superconducting electrodynamic suspension. Explain that gap errors affect force through system-specific magnetic mechanisms requiring separate models.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有磁浮列車都能直接使用同一個靜態吸力公式 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every maglev train can use the same static attraction formula directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model" is correct?
options: 所有磁浮列車都能直接使用同一個靜態吸力公式
只用理想均勻氣隙的靜態磁壓說明磁通平方的尺度關係，不把它冒充超導電動懸浮。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: Every maglev train can use the same static attraction formula directly.
Use ideal uniform-gap static pressure only to illustrate square-flux scaling, not superconducting electrodynamic suspension.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 只用理想均勻氣隙的靜態磁壓說明磁通平方的尺度關係，不把它冒充超導電動懸浮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use ideal uniform-gap static pressure only to illustrate square-flux scaling, not superconducting electrodynamic suspension. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。公式 y=B*B*A/(2*mu0)/1000，代入得 y=2.86479 kN。邊界：均勻理想氣隙的靜態磁壓，不是超導電動懸浮系統的完整力模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m. Formula y=B*B*A/(2*mu0)/1000 gives y=2.86479 kN. Boundary: Static magnetic pressure in an ideal uniform air gap, not a complete superconducting electrodynamic-suspension force model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在低能量封閉教具同時量間隙、磁通與力，檢查平方關係並標出飽和區域。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In an enclosed low-energy teaching rig, measure gap, flux and force together, testing square scaling and identifying saturation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。公式 y=B*B*A/(2*mu0)/1000，代入得 y=2.86479 kN。邊界：均勻理想氣隙的靜態磁壓，不是超導電動懸浮系統的完整力模型。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m. Formula y=B*B*A/(2*mu0)/1000 gives y=2.86479 kN. Boundary: Static magnetic pressure in an ideal uniform air gap, not a complete superconducting electrodynamic-suspension force model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：代表磁通密度 B=0.6 T；作用面積 A=0.02 m2；真空導磁率 mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: representative flux density B=0.6 T; active area A=0.02 m2; vacuum permeability mu0=1.25664e-06 H/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理想吸力模型的適用邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在低能量封閉教具同時量間隙、磁通與力，檢查平方關係並標出飽和區域。以「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In an enclosed low-energy teaching rig, measure gap, flux and force together, testing square scaling and identifying saturation. For limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把代表磁通密度 B 從 0.6 改成 0.66 T（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.86479 變為 3.46639 kN。先說明「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only representative flux density B from 0.6 to 0.66 T (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.86479 to 3.46639 kN. Explain the causal direction for limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把磁場讀值所在位置與有效氣隙混淆會錯估力，結構變形又可能改變間隙形成回饋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing probe location with effective air gap biases force; structural deformation can alter the gap and create feedback. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在低能量封閉教具同時量間隙、磁通與力，檢查平方關係並標出飽和區域。以「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把代表磁通密度 B 從 0.6 改成 0.66 T（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.86479 變為 3.46639 kN。先說明「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想吸力模型的適用邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model"?
options: 在低能量封閉教具同時量間隙、磁通與力，檢查平方關係並標出飽和區域。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
幾何最大誤差一樣時所有波長的乘坐影響一定一樣
optionsEn: In an enclosed low-energy teaching rig, measure gap, flux and force together, testing square scaling and identifying saturation.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal maximum geometry error gives identical ride effects at every wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 在低能量封閉教具同時量間隙、磁通與力，檢查平方關係並標出飽和區域。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In an enclosed low-energy teaching rig, measure gap, flux and force together, testing square scaling and identifying saturation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Limits of an ideal magnetic-attraction model: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 比較導梁位置資料和車體加速度時，先確認兩者使用同一時間基準。校時偏移會把反應配到錯誤位置，因此需在推論幾何原因前核對事件對齊。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何與車體量測時間鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm a common timebase before comparing guideway position data with vehicle acceleration. Clock offsets can associate a response with the wrong location, so alignment precedes geometric causal claims. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Timing of geometry and vehicle measurements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「幾何與車體量測時間鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for timing of geometry and vehicle measurements. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.explanationEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 測量施工與運行邊界與有限合格紀錄的外推

steps.title: 測量施工與運行邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey, construction and running cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測量施工與運行邊界」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey, construction and running cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把梁段製作、安裝定位和運行量測分成不同證據層，不能以其中一層合格替代全部。建立速度、溫度與支承條件的案例矩陣，保留未驗證的動態耦合。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測量施工與運行邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate fabrication, erection and running evidence rather than allowing one successful layer to stand for all. Build speed, temperature and support cases while retaining unverified dynamic coupling. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey, construction and running cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey, construction and running cases”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「測量施工與運行邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.

steps.title: 測量施工與運行邊界：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測量施工與運行邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey, construction and running cases” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey, construction and running cases” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「測量施工與運行邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 有限合格紀錄的外推：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Extrapolating finite successful records: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有限合格紀錄的外推」如何影響磁浮列車軌道梁精度控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Extrapolating finite successful records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guideway precision control for maglev”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續相鄰測點往往相關，全部合格不能直接當成大量獨立零失效試驗。先定義抽樣母體與獨立單位，再解讀上界並限制對未測梁段的外推。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有限合格紀錄的外推」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Adjacent measurements are often correlated and cannot become many independent failure-free trials merely by passing. Define the population and independent units before interpreting a bound or extrapolating to unmeasured sections. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Extrapolating finite successful records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有限合格紀錄的外推」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Extrapolating finite successful records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
